description: Create a standalone, text-clean 3D Lulu-style image from a user-supplied scene, then overlay exact subtitles.

steps.action: extract camera, posture, head direction, eye direction, lighting, costume, frame ratio
enforce orange no-nose lower face, round large head, blue eyes, tiny ears, top orange, short arms and legs
use available image editing/generation ability; output one text-free image; preserve original scene's expressive beats
review references/QA_CHECKLIST.md; regenerate or locally edit if mismatch
verify exact Chinese caption, visual similarity, eyes, short proportions, no overlays, one image per scene
